title: Elodie and the Ledger Revisited
author: R. M. Quintana
blurb: Freya Eastwick, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
